decisions.reason: After three years with only an initial website mention and no later visible market support, this line extension looks to have revealed limited standalone value, so the option should be closed and resources redeployed.

Because it received its own product page at launch and fits the firm’s core heating range, it still appears to be one of the more credible options worth keeping in the portfolio unless stronger negative evidence emerges.
With only a brief 2019 mention and no sign of continued prominence, the product’s uncertainty has largely resolved unfavorably and it is not attractive enough to justify further portfolio space.

This product seems to have generated weak observable follow-through after launch and overlaps with other infrared heater variants, so real-options logic favors abandoning it rather than maintaining another low-value option.
Its dedicated page suggests a higher initial commercial commitment and potentially clearer customer positioning within the firm’s established offer, making it a reasonable option to continue.
Given the sparse evidence of market traction and its apparent similarity to other tube-heater variants, keeping this option open offers little additional upside relative to its portfolio complexity.
